correctness.rationale: The standard quaternion presentation gives H=F+Kj, A=F, and the explicit quotient action (c+dj).z=c^2 z+b d^2 sigma(z). A finite 2-basis containing b decomposes K into direct K^2-blocks that are exactly the Q-spans of the proposed basis vectors, so the coordinate projections give all root-linear maps.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source explicitly leaves constructive quaternion root-linear maps open while proving only abstract existence via a basis of H/A. Targeted searches did not locate the finite-2-rank coordinate basis or its resulting explicit range-compatible normal form; older quaternion/p-basis literature remains a terminology-level residual risk.

value.rationale: The result replaces a stated nonconstructive gap by finite coordinates, computes dim_Q(H/A)=2^(r-1), parametrizes every root-linear map, and yields a concrete F_2((t)) formula and an explicit normal form for all nonlocal terms in the recent Hermitian-matrix classification.
